entries.summary: Opens the document: one `.awl` file declares exactly one workflow, named here.
examples:
//! Greet whoever starts the run.
workflow greet_visitor
  input name: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

step greet
  "hello " + name -> greeting
  route done(greeting)

//! `workflow.id` names this very run — here handed to a coordinator.
workflow register_run
  input coordinator_id: String
  send registered: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

step register
  send registered(workflow.id) to coordinator_id
  route done(workflow.id)
entries.citation: AWL reference §1 — Document structure

entries.summary: Declares one field of the workflow's start contract; it is repeatable.
examples:
//! Each `input` line declares one field of the start contract.
workflow open_ticket
  input title: String
  input urgent: Bool
  outcome done: type String, route success

step file
  outcome fast: when urgent, route done("expedited: " + title)
  outcome slow: otherwise, route done("queued: " + title)

//! Inputs can be records and lists, typed like any other value.
workflow plan_rollout
  input change: Change
  input hosts: [String]
  outcome done: type String, route success

type Change { title: String }

step plan
  hosts |> count -> planned
  outcome big: when planned > 3, route done("staged rollout of " + change.title)
  outcome small: otherwise, route done("direct rollout of " + change.title)
entries.citation: AWL reference §3 — Workflow header

entries.summary: Declares a durable signal this workflow receives; a step body takes delivery with `wait`.
examples:
//! Hold until the declared approval signal arrives.
workflow release_gate
  input build_id: String
  signal approval: Approval
  outcome done: type String, route success

type Approval { reviewer: String }

step hold
  wait approval -> decision
  route done(decision.reviewer + " approved " + build_id)

//! Two declared signals: a review verdict, then a go-ahead to ship.
workflow two_gate_release
  input build_id: String
  signal verdict: Verdict
  signal go: Go
  outcome done: type String, route success

type Verdict { approved: Bool }
type Go      { operator: String }

step review
  wait verdict -> review_verdict

step ship
  wait go -> clearance
  outcome shipped: when review_verdict.approved, route done(clearance.operator)
  outcome held: otherwise, route done("held: " + build_id)
entries.citation: AWL reference §3 — Workflow header

entries.summary: Declares a terminal payload in the workflow header, and a guarded arm inside a step body.
examples:
//! `outcome` declares terminals in the header and guarded arms in a step.
workflow triage_alert
  input urgent: Bool
  outcome paged:  type String, route success
  outcome logged: type String, route success

step decide
  outcome page: when urgent, route paged("paged the operator")
  outcome log: otherwise, route logged("logged for morning")

//! A subflow declares exactly one typed outcome of its own.
workflow audit_repo
  input repo: String
  outcome done: type Audit, route success

type Audit { clean: Bool }

worker auditors
  action scan(target: String) -> Audit

subflow audit_once(target: String)
  outcome out: type Audit

  step look
    scan(target: target) -> audit
    route out(audit)

step audit
  audit_once(target: repo) -> audit

step finish
  audit |> route done
entries.citation: AWL reference §7 — Selection, outcomes, and routes

entries.summary: Declares a record, an enum, or a schema door, and names the type an `outcome` carries.
examples:
//! Declare an enum and a record, then build one for the outcome.
workflow triage_ticket
  input note: String
  outcome done: type Triage, route success

type Category = Urgent | Routine
type Triage { category: Category, note: String }

step judge
  route done(category: Routine, note: note)
entries.citation: AWL reference §2 — Values and types

entries.summary: Opens a schema door: `schema("path")` imports one, `schema { … }` inlines one, and `schema of Type` derives one in constant position.
examples:
//! `schema of Type` in constant position, handed to an agent action.
workflow structured_reply
  input question: String
  outcome done: type Answer, route success

const answer_schema = schema of Answer

type Answer { reply: String }

worker assistants
  action ask(prompt: String, output_schema: String) -> Answer

step ask
  ask(prompt: question, output_schema: answer_schema) -> result
  route done(result)

//! Import a schema file as a type; the path resolves beside the document.
workflow ingest_existing
  input raw: Existing
  outcome done: type Existing, route success

type Existing = schema("schemas/existing.schema.json")

step accept
  route done(raw)
entries.citation: AWL reference §2 — Values and types

entries.summary: Declares a typed worker contract whose name is the task queue; it is a requirement, never an implementation.
examples:
//! The worker block is a typed requirement on the `greeter` task queue.
workflow greet_politely
  input name: String
  outcome done: type Greeting, route success

type Greeting { text: String }

worker greeter
  action greet(name: String) -> Greeting

step greet
  greet(name: name) -> reply
  route done(reply)
entries.citation: AWL reference §4 — Workers, actions, and calls

entries.summary: Declares one wire contract on a worker: named parameters, one return type, and at most one config line.
examples:
//! Each action line is one wire contract: named parameters, one return.
workflow inspect_repo
  input repo: String
  outcome done: type Report, route success

type Report { summary: String }

worker inspectors
  action inspect(repo: String) -> Report

step inspect
  inspect(repo: repo) -> report
  route done(report)
entries.citation: AWL reference §4 — Workers, actions, and calls

entries.summary: Declares a separate durable workflow this one may call and await.
examples:
//! Call a separate durable workflow and await its result.
workflow grade_essay
  input essay: String
  outcome done: type Grade, route success

type Grade { score: Int }

child score_essay(essay: String) -> Grade

step grade
  score_essay(essay: essay) -> grade
  route done(grade)

//! Await one child; detach another this run never waits for.
workflow grade_and_notify
  input essay: String
  outcome done: type Grade, route success

type Grade { score: Int }

child score_essay(essay: String) -> Grade
child notify_graded(score: Int) -> Nil

step grade
  score_essay(essay: essay) -> grade
  spawn notify_graded(score: grade.score)
  route done(grade)
entries.citation: AWL reference §5 — Children and subflows

entries.summary: Declares one node of the step graph; the statements inside it run in written order.
examples:
//! Statements inside a step run in written order; steps chain the graph.
workflow compose_greeting
  input name: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

step compose
  "hello " + name -> greeting

step deliver
  route done(greeting)

//! A body-less step of only outcomes is a pure decision.
workflow sort_ticket
  input urgent: Bool
  outcome fast: type String, route success
  outcome slow: type String, route success

step triage
  outcome now: when urgent, route fast("page")
  outcome later: otherwise, route slow("queue")
entries.citation: AWL reference §6 — Steps, dependencies, and calls

entries.summary: Names the steps a step waits for, so the dependency is written rather than inferred from position.
examples:
//! `verify` waits for `build`: the dependency is written, not inferred.
workflow gated_build
  input tag: String
  outcome done: type Checked, route success

type Built   { artifact: String }
type Checked { ok: Bool }

worker ci
  action build(tag: String) -> Built
  action verify(artifact: String) -> Checked

step build
  build(tag: tag) -> built

step verify after build
  verify(artifact: built.artifact) -> checked
  route done(checked)

//! A diamond: build and notes run independently, publish waits for both.
workflow release_notes
  input tag: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

type Build { artifact: String }
type Notes { text: String }

worker release
  action build(tag: String) -> Build
  action render_notes(tag: String) -> Notes

step start
  "release " + tag -> label

step build after start
  build(tag: tag) -> built

step notes after start
  render_notes(tag: tag) -> rendered

step publish after build, notes
  route done(label + " " + built.artifact + rendered.text)
entries.citation: AWL reference §6 — Steps, dependencies, and calls

entries.summary: Runs work concurrently inside one step: `fork item in items` one branch per item, or a bare `fork` for named branches.
examples:
//! One branch per repo, checked in parallel, joined in input order.
workflow sweep_repos
  input repos: [String]
  outcome done: type [Verdict], route success

type Verdict { ok: Bool }

worker ci
  action check(repo: String) -> Verdict

step sweep
  fork repo in repos
    check(repo: repo)
  join -> verdicts
  route done(verdicts)

//! A bare fork runs named heterogeneous calls concurrently.
workflow load_dashboard
  input user_id: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

type Profile { name: String }
type History { entries: Int }

worker accounts
  action fetch_profile(id: String) -> Profile
  action fetch_history(id: String) -> History

step load
  fork
    fetch_profile(id: user_id) -> profile
    fetch_history(id: user_id) -> history
  join
  outcome busy: when history.entries > 3, route done(profile.name + " is busy")
  outcome quiet: otherwise, route done(profile.name)
entries.citation: AWL reference §8 — Parallel and sequential work

entries.summary: Closes a `fork`, binding a collection fork's results in input order.
examples:
//! `join` closes the fork, binding the branches' results in input order.
workflow gather_reports
  input repos: [String]
  outcome done: type [Report], route success

type Report { summary: String }

worker inspectors
  action inspect(repo: String) -> Report

step gather
  fork repo in repos
    inspect(repo: repo)
  join -> reports
  route done(reports)

//! Bare `join` closes named branches; there is no collection to bind.
workflow warm_caches
  input region: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

worker infra
  action warm_dns(region: String) -> Nil
  action warm_cdn(region: String) -> Nil

step warm
  fork
    warm_dns(region: region)
    warm_cdn(region: region)
  join
  route done(region)
entries.citation: AWL reference §8 — Parallel and sequential work

entries.summary: Runs a bounded value-threading loop whose body runs at least once and must rebind the threaded value.
examples:
//! Improve the draft until it is ready, at most three passes.
workflow refine_draft
  input topic: String
  outcome done:  type Draft,  route success
  outcome stuck: type String, route failure

type Draft { body: String, ready: Bool }

worker writers
  action improve(topic: String, prior: Draft) -> Draft

step refine
  loop draft = Draft(body: "", ready: false)
    improve(topic: topic, prior: draft) -> draft
    until draft.ready
    max 3
  outcome ready: when draft.ready, route done(draft)
  outcome exhausted: otherwise, route stuck("the draft never settled")

//! The threaded value carries state between passes; rounds are counted.
workflow tune_model
  input target: String
  outcome done:  type Int,    route success
  outcome stuck: type String, route failure

type Tuning { score: Int, good_enough: Bool }

worker lab
  action tune(target: String, prior: Tuning) -> Tuning

step tune
  loop tuning = Tuning(score: 0, good_enough: false) counting rounds
    tune(target: target, prior: tuning) -> tuning
    until tuning.good_enough
    max 8
  outcome tuned: when tuning.good_enough, route done(rounds)
  outcome gave_up: otherwise, route stuck(target)
entries.citation: AWL reference §9 — Bounded iteration

entries.summary: Binds the number of completed iterations of a `loop`.
examples:
//! `counting` binds how many iterations the loop completed.
workflow poll_job
  input job: String
  outcome done:  type Int,    route success
  outcome stuck: type String, route failure

type Status { ready: Bool }

worker jobs
  action poll(job: String, prior: Status) -> Status

step watch
  loop status = Status(ready: false) counting polls
    poll(job: job, prior: status) -> status
    until status.ready
    max 10
  outcome ready: when status.ready, route done(polls)
  outcome gave_up: otherwise, route stuck(job)
entries.citation: AWL reference §9 — Bounded iteration

entries.summary: States the condition that ends a `loop`, tested after the body has run.
examples:
//! `until` ends the loop, tested after each pass of the body.
workflow stabilize_build
  input tag: String
  outcome done:  type Build,  route success
  outcome stuck: type String, route failure

type Build { green: Bool }

worker ci
  action rebuild(tag: String, prior: Build) -> Build

step converge
  loop build = Build(green: false)
    rebuild(tag: tag, prior: build) -> build
    until build.green
    max 5
  outcome green: when build.green, route done(build)
  outcome exhausted: otherwise, route stuck(tag)

//! A compound condition: stop only when ready AND approved.
workflow draft_and_signoff
  input topic: String
  outcome done:  type Draft,  route success
  outcome stuck: type String, route failure

type Draft { ready: Bool, approved: Bool }

worker desks
  action revise(topic: String, prior: Draft) -> Draft

step converge
  loop draft = Draft(ready: false, approved: false)
    revise(topic: topic, prior: draft) -> draft
    until draft.ready and draft.approved
    max 6
  outcome settled: when draft.ready and draft.approved, route done(draft)
  outcome exhausted: otherwise, route stuck(topic)
entries.citation: AWL reference §9 — Bounded iteration

entries.summary: Bounds iteration: the mandatory ceiling on a `loop`, or `max N visits` on a step inside a flow loop.
examples:
//! `max` is the mandatory ceiling; exhaustion is a distinct outcome.
workflow negotiate_quote
  input request: String
  outcome done:  type Offer,  route success
  outcome stuck: type String, route failure

type Offer { accepted: Bool }

worker brokers
  action haggle(request: String, prior: Offer) -> Offer

step negotiate
  loop offer = Offer(accepted: false)
    haggle(request: request, prior: offer) -> offer
    until offer.accepted
    max 4
  outcome agreed: when offer.accepted, route done(offer)
  outcome exhausted: otherwise, route stuck(request)

//! The other place `max` stands: a visit bound on a step in a flow loop.
workflow polish_copy
  input text: String
  outcome done: type Verdict, route success

type Verdict { ok: Bool }

worker desks
  action review(text: String) -> Verdict

step review
  review(text: text) -> verdict

step judge
  outcome again: when not verdict.ok and visits < 2, route review
  outcome settled: otherwise, route done(verdict)
  max 2 visits
entries.citation: AWL reference §9 — Bounded iteration

entries.summary: Runs a collection `fork` one item at a time in input order instead of in parallel.
examples:
//! `sequential` publishes one target at a time, in input order.
workflow publish_targets
  input targets: [String]
  outcome done: type [Receipt], route success

type Receipt { target: String }

worker publisher
  action publish(target: String) -> Receipt

step publish_all
  fork target in targets sequential
    publish(target: target)
  join -> receipts
  route done(receipts)
entries.citation: AWL reference §8 — Parallel and sequential work

entries.summary: Starts a child workflow without waiting for it, so it can bind no result.
examples:
//! Start a child without waiting; it can bind no result.
workflow archive_report
  input report_id: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

child notify_archived(report_id: String) -> Nil

step archive
  spawn notify_archived(report_id: report_id)
  route done(report_id)
entries.citation: AWL reference §5 — Children and subflows

entries.summary: Waits for a declared signal and binds it; a `timeout` makes that binding optional, because expiry is absence.
examples:
//! Take delivery of the declared signal, binding its payload.
workflow hold_for_go
  input build_id: String
  signal go: Approval
  outcome done: type String, route success

type Approval { approver: String }

step hold
  wait go -> approval
  route done(approval.approver + " released " + build_id)

//! A timed wait binds an optional, because expiry is absence.
workflow ask_signoff
  input change_id: String
  signal signoff: Signoff
  outcome shipped:   type String, route success
  outcome escalated: type String, route failure

type Signoff { reviewer: String }

step hold
  wait signoff timeout 2d -> decision
  outcome approved: when decision is present, route shipped(decision.reviewer)
  outcome lapsed: otherwise, route escalated("lapsed: " + change_id)
entries.citation: AWL reference §10 — Waits, timeouts, signals, and sleep

entries.summary: Sleeps for a duration on a durable timer.
examples:
//! Sleep on a durable timer; the run survives a restart mid-sleep.
workflow cool_down
  input build_id: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

step pause
  sleep 30s
  route done(build_id)

//! Sleep between polls: a durable timer inside the loop body.
workflow await_export
  input job: String
  outcome done:  type Status, route success
  outcome stuck: type String, route failure

type Status { finished: Bool }

worker exports
  action poll(job: String, prior: Status) -> Status

step watch
  loop status = Status(finished: false)
    sleep 30s
    poll(job: job, prior: status) -> status
    until status.finished
    max 20
  outcome finished: when status.finished, route done(status)
  outcome timed_out: otherwise, route stuck(job)
entries.citation: AWL reference §10 — Waits, timeouts, signals, and sleep

entries.summary: Bounds the workflow run in the header, one activity on an action or call, or one `wait` — three distinct places.
examples:
//! The header timeout bounds the whole run.
workflow nightly_sweep
  timeout 2h
  input target: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

step sweep
  route done("swept " + target)

//! An activity timeout on the declaration, tightened at one call site.
workflow build_twice
  input tag: String
  outcome done: type Build, route success

type Build { artifact: String }

worker builders
  action build(tag: String) -> Build
    timeout 30m

step quick_probe
  build(tag: tag) -> probe
    timeout 5m

step full_build
  build(tag: probe.artifact) -> built
  route done(built)

//! A wait with a timeout binds an optional: expiry is absence.
workflow hold_for_signoff
  input change_id: String
  signal signoff: Signoff
  outcome shipped:   type String, route success
  outcome escalated: type String, route failure

type Signoff { reviewer: String }

step hold
  wait signoff timeout 2d -> decision
  outcome approved: when decision is present, route shipped(decision.reviewer)
  outcome lapsed: otherwise, route escalated("window lapsed: " + change_id)
entries.citation: AWL reference §4 — Workers, actions, and calls

entries.summary: Sets an action's retry policy, as `retry N every DURATION` or `retry N backoff MIN..MAX`.
examples:
//! Retry the flaky pull three times before the step faults.
workflow sync_mirror
  input remote: String
  outcome done: type Synced, route success

type Synced { revision: String }

worker mirrors
  action pull(remote: String) -> Synced
    retry 3 every 30s

step pull
  pull(remote: remote) -> synced
  route done(synced)

//! The growing form: intervals stretch from five seconds toward four minutes.
workflow crawl_source
  input source: String
  outcome done: type Page, route success

type Page { body: String }

worker crawlers
  action crawl(source: String) -> Page
    retry 6 backoff 5s..4m

step crawl
  crawl(source: source) -> page
  route done(page)
entries.citation: AWL reference §4 — Workers, actions, and calls

entries.summary: Marks an action whose failure never faults its calling step; it can bind no result and be no pipe stage.
examples:
//! An advisory announcement can fail without faulting the run.
workflow ship_build
  input version: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

worker notifier
  action announce(version: String) -> Nil
    advisory, timeout 30s

step ship
  announce(version: version)
  route done(version)
entries.citation: AWL reference §4 — Workers, actions, and calls

entries.summary: Marks an action as an agent seam: its one `String` parameter carries a prompt and its `String` result the reply.
examples:
//! An agent action hands its prompt to a harness and binds the reply.
workflow ask_reviewer
  input question: String
  outcome done: type String, route success

worker assistants
  action ask(prompt: String) -> String
    agent, timeout 10m

step ask
  ask(prompt: question) -> reply
  route done(reply)
entries.citation: AWL reference §4 — Workers, actions, and calls

entries.summary: Sets the fixed interval between retries in `retry N every DURATION`.
examples:
//! `every` fixes the interval between retries: ten seconds, each time.
workflow ping_service
  input url: String
  outcome done: type Pong, route success

type Pong { latency_ms: Int }

worker probes
  action ping(url: String) -> Pong
    retry 5 every 10s

step ping
  ping(url: url) -> pong
  route done(pong)
entries.citation: AWL reference §4 — Workers, actions, and calls

entries.summary: Sets the growing retry interval in `retry N backoff MIN..MAX`.
examples:
//! `backoff` grows the retry interval from ten seconds toward two minutes.
workflow fetch_upstream
  input source: String
  outcome done: type Fetched, route success

type Fetched { bytes: Int }

worker fetchers
  action fetch(source: String) -> Fetched
    retry 4 backoff 10s..2m

step fetch
  fetch(source: source) -> fetched
  route done(fetched)
entries.citation: AWL reference §4 — Workers, actions, and calls

entries.summary: Pins dispatch to a named worker node, on the action declaration or overridden at a call site.
examples:
//! Pin an action's dispatch to the named worker node.
workflow build_release
  input tag: String
  outcome done: type Build, route success

type Build { artifact: String }

worker builders
  action build(tag: String) -> Build
    node linux_large

step build
  build(tag: tag) -> built
  route done(built)

//! Override the declared node at one urgent call site.
workflow hotfix_build
  input tag: String
  outcome done: type Build, route success

type Build { artifact: String }

worker builders
  action build(tag: String) -> Build
    node standard, timeout 30m

step build
  build(tag: tag) -> built
    node urgent, timeout 5m
  route done(built)
entries.citation: AWL reference §4 — Workers, actions, and calls

entries.summary: Opens `on failure`, the block a step runs when it faults, which must itself end in a route.
examples:
//! `on failure` runs when the step faults, and must end in a route.
workflow publish_package
  input name: String
  outcome done:   type String, route success
  outcome failed: type String, route failure

worker registry
  action publish(name: String) -> Nil
  action yank(name: String) -> Nil

step publish
  publish(name: name)
  route done(name)

  on failure
    yank(name: name)
    route failed("publish failed; yanked")

//! Compensation may route back into the graph, not only to an outcome.
workflow deploy_with_rollback
  input build: String
  outcome done:   type String, route success
  outcome failed: type String, route failure

worker ops
  action deploy(build: String) -> Nil
  action rollback(build: String) -> Nil
  action report(build: String) -> Nil

step deploy
  deploy(build: build)
  route done(build)

  on failure
    rollback(build: build)
    route notify

step notify
  report(build: build)
  route failed("deploy failed; rolled back: " + build)
entries.citation: AWL reference §11 — Failure handling

entries.summary: Maps a declared outcome to the engine's failed status, and after `on` names a step's compensation block.
examples:
//! `route failure` marks the outcome that fails the run.
workflow validate_order
  input order_id: String
  input valid: Bool
  outcome accepted: type String, route success
  outcome rejected: type String, route failure

step validate
  outcome ok: when valid, route accepted(order_id)
  outcome bad: otherwise, route rejected("invalid order: " + order_id)

//! After `on`, the same word names a step's compensation block.
workflow guard_import
  input dataset: String
  outcome done:   type String, route success
  outcome failed: type String, route failure

worker importers
  action import_rows(dataset: String) -> Nil

step import
  import_rows(dataset: dataset)
  route done(dataset)

  on failure
    route failed("import faulted: " + dataset)
entries.citation: AWL reference §3 — Workflow header

entries.summary: Guards an outcome arm; the first true guard wins, and its proofs narrow optionals through that arm.
examples:
//! The first true `when` wins; its proofs hold through the arm.
workflow admit_finding
  input finding: Finding
  outcome done: type String, route success

type Finding { blocking: Bool, detail: String? }

step judge
  outcome real: when finding.detail is present, route done(finding.detail)
  outcome noise: otherwise, route done("no detail recorded")

//! Guards over every enum variant are total; no `otherwise` needed.
workflow route_ticket
  input ticket: Ticket
  outcome done: type String, route success

type Category = Urgent | Routine | Spam
type Ticket { category: Category }

step route_it
  outcome page: when ticket.category == Urgent, route done("page")
  outcome queue: when ticket.category == Routine, route done("queue")
  outcome bin: when ticket.category == Spam, route done("discard")
entries.citation: AWL reference §7 — Selection, outcomes, and routes

entries.summary: The complement arm of a guarded outcome set, which must come last.
examples:
//! `otherwise` is the complement arm, and must come last.
workflow rate_change
  input risky: Bool
  outcome done: type String, route success

step rate
  outcome careful: when risky, route done("hold for review")
  outcome fine: otherwise, route done("ship it")
entries.citation: AWL reference §7 — Selection, outcomes, and routes

entries.summary: Sends flow to another step or to a declared outcome, supplying that outcome's payload.
examples:
//! `route` sends flow to another step or to a declared outcome.
workflow escalate_alert
  input urgent: Bool
  outcome done: type String, route success

step assess
  outcome page: when urgent, route page_operator
  outcome log: otherwise, route done("logged")

step page_operator
  route done("paged")

//! A backward route makes a flow loop; the cycle carries a visit bound.
workflow retry_gate
  input repo: String
  outcome done:   type Verdict, route success
  outcome failed: type String,  route failure

type Verdict { ok: Bool }

worker ci
  action check(repo: String) -> Verdict

step attempt
  check(repo: repo) -> verdict

step judge
  outcome again: when not verdict.ok and visits < 3, route attempt
  outcome good: when verdict.ok, route done(verdict)
  outcome exhausted: otherwise, route failed(repo)
  max 3 visits
entries.citation: AWL reference §7 — Selection, outcomes, and routes

entries.summary: Maps a declared outcome to the engine's completed status.
examples:
//! `route success` maps the outcome to the engine's completed status.
